test.create_query: CREATE TABLE column_string_filter (n UInt64, s String, t String, fixed String, arr Array(UInt64)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY n
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO column_string_filter SELECT number, if(number % 1000 = 0, '', repeat('a', 20 + intHash32(number) % 101)), repeat('b', intHash32(number) % 3), leftPad(toString(number % 100000000), 8, '0'), range(intHash32(number) % 10) FROM numbers_mt(40000000)
